items.l1: The prize draw is undoubtedly the part that stirs people the most; from practical electronic products to valuable travel vouchers, the prizes are revealed one after another, and cheers burst out from the audience from time to time.
items.notes: Low only from synonym choice (牵动人心/依次 vs 让人激动/一个接一个); facts, scope and order all match; unchanged.

items.l1: After a long time like this, the patience between parents and children is worn down, and the parents' own rest and emotions are also affected.
items.notes: Faithful; distance is 长期如此/消耗 vs 长此以往/消磨, both valid renderings; unchanged.

items.l1: If you want to allocate transport capacity well in advance, you cannot do without scientific forecasting.
items.notes: Loose: 'make good arrangements' blurred 运力调配 (allocation) and lost the 要想...就离不开 frame; rewrote to 'allocate' and 'cannot do without'.

items.l1: Squeezed between chain convenience stores and large supermarkets, the neighborhood shop can still take root, relying not on scale but on the web of personal relationships deeply embedded in the community.
items.notes: Faithful; distance from 小卖部/夹缝中 wording; 'neighborhood shop' kept for consistency with the next sentence's reference; unchanged.

items.l1: The shop owner remembers residents' tastes, family circumstances and spending habits, and can offer flexibility in small details such as buying on credit, delivery and emergency help.
items.notes: Faithful item for item (赊账, 送货, 临时救急, 提供弹性); low score is synonym variance; unchanged.

items.l1: This term is not just a joke; it reminds people that a house can indeed bring a sense of stability, but it may also compress the room for choice over many years to come.
items.notes: Loose lexis: 'security' points to 安全感 not 安定感, 'label' and 'squeeze' drift from 称呼 and 压缩; rewrote to 'term', 'stability', 'compress'.

items.l1: Parents believe that as long as they buy here, their child will be able to enroll smoothly and avoid the cruel competition of choosing a school.
items.notes: Faithful; blind back-translation matched gold almost word for word; unchanged.

items.l1: For a single school place, the household registrations of several families may be crammed into the same apartment.
items.notes: Faithful (学位名额, 好几户, 户口, 同一套房子); the 0.40 reflects first reviewer's back-translation variance, not a loose reference; unchanged.

items.l1: The seller hesitated for a moment, and in the end agreed to lower the price by 150 yuan, and they arranged to hand it over at the entrance of the residential compound the next afternoon.
items.notes: 150 matches 一百五 and yuan is implied by the prior 两百元; distance from 片刻/次日/交接 synonyms; unchanged.

items.l1: The bus station was noisy with voices, the electronic screens kept announcing delays, and I clutched my ticket, afraid of missing this bus home.
items.notes: Faithful; 'this bus home' is a natural rendering of 这趟归途 given the context; unchanged.

items.l1: Along the way I also had to change buses in a small town, because there was only one direct bus to my old home each day.
items.notes: Faithful; explicit 'I' is implied by the narrative; distance is wording variance only; unchanged.

items.l1: This dish seems simple, but in fact it holds hidden subtleties.
items.notes: Loose: 'some tricks' reads as 窍门 (knack), not 暗藏玄机 (hidden subtlety); rewrote to 'holds hidden subtleties'.

items.l1: Her mother stressed repeatedly that the heat is the key to success or failure: if the oil is too hot, the beaten egg will scorch in an instant; if the temperature is not enough, the egg will have difficulty becoming fluffy.
items.notes: Faithful clause for clause; blind back-translation near identical to gold; unchanged.

items.l1: Lin Yue adjusted the heat as told, and only after seeing the edges of the beaten egg bubble slightly did she slowly push in the cut tomatoes.
items.notes: Faithful; distance from literary 依言/眼见/缓缓 vs plain synonyms; unchanged.

items.l1: When the sweet and sour aroma spilled out of the screen, Lin Yue suddenly understood that the so-called taste of home has never been one particular recipe, but someone being willing, across a screen, to hand you the small details of proportion bit by bit.
items.notes: Faithful to a literary gold (琐碎的分寸一寸寸交到你手上) with several valid renderings; unchanged.

items.l1: The bride's mother did not state a position right away, and only asked one thing: will our daughter's name be written on the property certificate?
items.notes: Faithful; 'our' is the natural English for bare 女儿 in the mother's direct speech; unchanged.

items.l1: The children, however, often feel wronged: they are not refusing intimate relationships, but under the pressure of housing prices and career prospects, they want to keep the power of choice in their own hands.
items.notes: Faithful; distance from 并非/只是/希望 vs 并不是/而是/想 synonyms; unchanged.

items.l1: If you want to present the trend of data changing over time, such as a city's temperature fluctuations over a year, a line chart is more suitable, and a continuous line can clearly show the direction of rises and falls.
items.notes: Faithful; distance from formal 倘若/例如/则更为 vs plain equivalents; unchanged.

items.l1: Looking at cost-effectiveness alone, the canteen seems to have the advantage: no shopping, no cooking, a meal settled by swiping a card, with the time cost compressed to the minimum.
items.notes: Faithful; distance from 无需采购/烹饪 vs 不用买菜/做饭; unchanged.

items.l1: By contrast, the packed-lunch crowd can independently control the source and proportions of their ingredients, with little oil and salt and a balance of meat and vegetables, which both looks after the stomach and saves a considerable amount of expense each month.
items.notes: Faithful; distance from 反观便当一族/配比 vs 相比之下带饭族/比例; unchanged.

items.l1: Its appearance often means that the prevention and control measures are beginning to show results, but it does not mean the risk has been eliminated.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's compressed 成效初显/不等于 has several valid renderings; unchanged.

items.l1: True confidence does not come from endlessly approaching the filter, but stems from accepting one's own uniqueness: acknowledging that one has imperfections, yet still being willing to face the camera calmly.
items.notes: Faithful; distance from nominal 对自身独特性的接纳 vs verbal phrasing; unchanged.

items.l1: Only when I act accordingly do I feel at ease.
items.notes: Faithful to 我照此行事，心里才踏实; the 0.30 is short-sentence variance in the first back-translation; unchanged.
